prediction.rationale:
Cooler: reduced efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 40.4 °C (30% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 44.8 °C (25% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 47.0 °C (21% above healthy). Heat exchanger effectiveness has dropped below optimal threshold, producing elevated mean temperatures.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.1 s (3% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.70 s (5% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.44 l/min (2% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 383 W·min/l (within 1% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.9 % (3% below healthy). Slight elevation in power-to-flow ratio reflects incipient volumetric efficiency loss.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.9 bar (within 1% of healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.
